gu.upToDateBody: NoCapOS {version} and the system's packages are current.
gu.sumRepair: The system's packages need a repair
gu.bodySec: Security fixes are included; install them soon.
gu.bodyKernel: Includes a kernel update, so restart the machine afterwards.
gu.askMsg: Installs {what} in one run. Your settings, apps and files are kept.
gu.askRestartNoc: NoCapOS restarts itself at the end.
gu.runningBody: This can take a few minutes. You can keep using NoCapOS while the system packages install.
gu.restartNeeded: Restart the machine to finish updating (a new kernel is installed).
gi.askBody: The new system ({size}) downloads and is prepared next to the one you're using. You can keep working; restart when it's ready. Your files, apps and settings are kept.
gi.restartBody: The machine restarts into the new system. If anything about it doesn't work, it goes back to this one by itself.
gi.restartingBody: NoCapOS will be back in a minute or two. This page reconnects by itself.
gi.installingBody: Downloading only what changed and writing it next to the running system. Keep using NoCapOS meanwhile.
gi.readyBody: Restart to finish. If the new system doesn't start properly, the machine goes back to this one by itself.
gi.checkingNewBody: NoCapOS just restarted into the update and is making sure everything works before keeping it.
gi.secBody: Fixes from Debian for {n} package(s) in the system. Install it soon.
gi.availableBody: The whole system updates in one piece and can't be left half-installed.
gi.failed: The update to {version} couldn't be prepared. Nothing changed.
gi.updated: Updated to NoCapOS {version}. Everything checked out.
gi.rolledBack: The update to {version} was undone: NoCapOS went back to {current}. Nothing was lost.
gi.reasonNoc: NoCapOS didn't start on the new system.
gi.reasonDesk: The screen's sign-in didn't start on the new system.
gi.reasonBoot: The new system didn't finish starting.
gi.reasonCommit: The new system couldn't be made the default.
gi.channelHint: Beta gets new versions earlier, before everyone else.
gi.autoSecHint: Security updates install by themselves around {time} and the machine restarts. New versions still wait for you.
gi.aboutImage: NoCapOS {version} · system packages from Debian as of {snapshot}. The system is read-only and updates as a whole.
